ALT-1001.rationale: Classic structuring pattern across multiple branches, far above the customer's normal takings, with funds consolidated and moved on. Refer to MLRO for SAR consideration.

ALT-1002.rationale: Credit matches the documented property sale (completion statement DOC-5531, amount and solicitor match). Funds moved to the customer's own ISA. No further action.

ALT-1003.rationale: Beneficiary name and country match designated entity SAN-0041. Potential true sanctions match: hold payment and refer to the sanctions team; L1 closure not permitted.

ALT-1004.rationale: Name similarity only. Listed person SAN-0107 was born in 1949 with QM nationality; customer was born in 1992, is a GB national verified by passport. False positive; close and record rationale.

ALT-1005.rationale: Strong money mule indicators: new unrelated payers, near-total onward movement within hours to a crypto exchange and ATM. Refer to MLRO; consider account restriction.

ALT-1006.rationale: Payment is to the long-standing supplier verified in the March 2026 EDD review (DOC-4417), invoice-referenced and in line with 6 months of history. No further action.

ALT-1007.rationale: Turnover roughly quadrupled with no explanation on file. Not clearly suspicious for a cafe (could be a new contract or event), so request an explanation and evidence from the customer.

ALT-1008.rationale: Large offshore payment to a PEP, inconsistent with the documented source of wealth and with no declared business interests; funds layered to a trust. Escalate for EDD and SAR consideration.

ALT-1009.rationale: Round-tripping with a related party: round amounts out, near-identical amounts back with changing references, no disclosed business rationale. Escalate for investigation.

ALT-1010.rationale: Contact details changed and a new payee added days before reactivation, then rapid outflow: indicates account takeover or the account being used as a mule. Escalate and restrict account.

ALT-1011.rationale: Income change documented and verified (DOC-7781, KYC refresh Aug 2026). One-off credit is a sign-on bonus from the same employer. No further action.

ALT-1012.rationale: Grant payments to QV partners are consistent with EDD. The £12,000 payment to an individual is not covered by the approved list; request the consultancy contract and trustee approval before deciding.

ALT-1013.rationale: Consistent with ticket sales in value, but the customer declared sales go through a card processor, not direct bank transfers. Request an explanation and sales records before deciding.
